# FortiGate: policies for the active VLANs on LAN-Bond-10G, inbound VIP policies (step 1c)
# Generated by plans/gen-fortigate-cli.py from the 13/14 Oct 2026 captures. Do not edit; re-run.
# Lines starting with # are comments for the reader; FortiOS ignores them when pasted.

# STEP 1c: firewall policies. One accept+NAT to x4 per active VLAN, mirroring the live pattern.
# Everyone egresses as 193.221.132.138 (plain NAT to the x4 address, no pool); only vlan54 and vlan71 use a pool.
# Whitelist/exception policies are created BEFORE the general policy of the same VLAN so they match first.
# All ids are "edit 0" (FortiOS assigns). Inactive and spare VLANs get no policy at all.

config firewall policy
    # Island management first: SW101, SW102, SW14 and every re-patched cabinet switch reach Nebula
    # through this (it replaces policy 34 "Interface LAN x1", deleted in 30-fgt-clear-x1-x2.txt).
    edit 0
        set name "LAN-10G mgmt -> internet"
        set srcintf "LAN-Bond-10G"
        set dstintf "x4"
        set action accept
        set srcaddr "LAN-Bond-10G address"
        set dstaddr "all"
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set utm-status enable
        set inspection-mode flow
        set profile-type single
        set profile-protocol-options "default"
        set ssl-ssh-profile "certificate-inspection"
        set webfilter-profile "default"
        set dnsfilter-profile "default"
        set application-list "default"
        set logtraffic utm
        set nat enable
        set comments "switch and AP management VLAN 1, 192.168.1.0/24; was policy 34 on x1"
    next

    # --- inbound to the two carried-over public IPs ---
    # Thames Reach: everything to 193.221.131.35 -> 192.168.54.253 (as the ATP500 1:1 did)
    edit 0
        set name "internet -> ThamesReach .35"
        set srcintf "x4"
        set dstintf "vlan54"
        set action accept
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "VIP-193.221.131.35-ThamesReach"
        set schedule "always"
        set service "ALL"
        set utm-status disable
        set ssl-ssh-profile "no-inspection"
        set logtraffic utm
        set nat disable
        set comments "carried from ATP500 VLAN54_THAMES"
    next
    # Cafe OTO: TCP/UDP 1000-2000 to 193.221.131.36 -> 192.168.71.1 (James Dunn, 23 Oct 2026)
    edit 0
        set name "internet -> CafeOTO .36"
        set srcintf "x4"
        set dstintf "vlan71"
        set action accept
        set srcaddr "all"
        set dstaddr "VIP-193.221.131.36-CafeOTO"
        set schedule "always"
        set service "CafeOTO-1000-2000"
        set utm-status disable
        set ssl-ssh-profile "no-inspection"
        set logtraffic utm
        set nat disable
        set comments "carried from ATP500 Vlan71_CafeOTO, fresh build"
    next
